description: This file defines the class tlIssueTracker, which manages various issue tracking systems within the TestLink project. It includes methods to handle CRUD operations for issue trackers, link them to test projects, and interface with different external bug/issue tracking systems via specified APIs.

classes.name: tlIssueTracker
classes.description: A class to manage various issue tracking servers (like Bugzilla, Mantis, Jira, etc.) for test projects within TestLink. It provides functionalities for CRUD operations, linking to test projects, and creating appropriate interface objects based on the tracker type.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the issue tracker object, fetching available tracker types and setting up database connection.

methods.name: getSystems
methods.description: Returns all configured issue tracking systems, optionally filtered by enabled/disabled status.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Returns a mapping of system codes to their type descriptions, used internally for display and logic.

methods.name: getImplementationForType
methods.description: Returns a string representing the class name of the interface implementation for a given issue tracker type.

methods.name: getEntitySpec
methods.description: Returns the entity specification array for creating or validating issue tracker entities.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new issue tracker record after validating configuration and sanitizing input.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing issue tracker record, ensuring no duplicate names and valid configuration.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an issue tracker record if it's not linked to any test projects.

methods.name: getByID
methods.description: Retrieves an issue tracker record by its ID.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves an issue tracker record by its name.

methods.name: getByAttr
methods.description: General method to retrieve an issue tracker record by a specified attribute and value.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes input object data for database operations, trimming strings and preparing them for safe database storage.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Creates a link between a test project and an issue tracker.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Removes the link between a test project and an issue tracker.

methods.name: getLinks
methods.description: Retrieves all test projects linked to a specific issue tracker.

methods.name: getLinkSet
methods.description: Returns all linked test project-issue tracker pairs.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all issue trackers with options for output formatting, ordering, and environment checks.

methods.name: getLinkedTo
methods.description: Returns the test project associated with a specific issue tracker ID.

methods.name: getInterfaceObject
methods.description: Returns the interface object for a linked issue tracker, creating and caching as needed.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks if the connection to an issue tracker works by instantiating its interface object and calling isConnected().

methods.name: checkXMLCfg
methods.description: Validates an XML configuration string for correctness by attempting to load it as XML.
